props.name: children
props.description: A set of Avatar components to stack

props.name: alignRight
props.description: Align the avatars to the right

props.name: disableExpand
props.description: Do not spread the avatars on hover

props.name: variant
props.description: The style of overlapping avatars. 'cascade' increases the overlap for 3rd+ avatars, while 'stack' uses a uniform overlap.

props.name: size
props.type: number | { narrow?: number; regular?: number; wide?: number; }
props.description: The size of the avatar children in pixels.
